lines.en: Chew on roots beneath the ice.

lines.zh: 象群踏着同一条雪径向前。
lines.en: The herd files forward along one trodden snow path.

lines.zh: 灰白的皮毛在风中飞扬。
lines.en: Gray fur sways in the wind.

lines.zh: 在雪地里留下深深的足迹。
lines.en: Leave deep footprints in the snow.

lines.zh: 巨颚张合，发出低沉的声音。
lines.en: Gape and make a low sound.

lines.zh: 用长鼻嗅探周围的环境。
巨大的身躯在冰原上移动。

lines.en: The herd walks the same snow trail.

lines.zh: 厚毛擦过冰丘，沙沙作响。
lines.en: My thick fur rasps against the ice ridge.

lines.zh: 我们围成圈，把小象挡在中间。
lines.en: We ring the calves inside the herd.
Under this shaggy coat it's warm.

lines.zh: 用长牙梳理自己的皮毛。

lines.en: Gently touch the calf with the nose.

lines.zh: 我守在育生舱旁守着幼崽。
lines.en: I stand by the incubator, guarding the calf.

lines.zh: 长鼻卷起一撮干草慢慢嚼。
lines.en: My trunk rolls up dry grass and chews slowly.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子把幼崽推回队伍。
lines.en: My trunk nudges the calf back into line.

lines.zh: 灰毛首领一停，全群都停下。
lines.en: When the grey leader halts, the herd halts.
I shake the snow off my back.

lines.zh: 冰原风声里，我低低应和。
lines.en: In the steppe wind, I answer low.

lines.zh: 察觉到你，高声咆哮警告。
用眼神警告你不要接近。
盯着你，显示出凶猛的气势。
发出警告的低吼，示意退后。
用长鼻触碰你，表示友好。
lines.en: Gently touch you with the nose.

lines.zh: 用长牙威胁，迫使你后退。

lines.en: Ice shards cling to my long fur.

lines.zh: 低吼，表示你闯入了它的领地。
lines.en: Roar that you've entered its territory.

lines.zh: 用长牙挑逗你，让你不敢靠近。
发出威吓的低吼，让你感到恐惧。
你的气味没有冰原的土味。
lines.en: Your scent carries none of the steppe.
I lift my head and the tusks move first.
Draw near, and you'll be my meal!

lines.zh: 冰原上的美味，被我发现！
lines.en: Flesh of the tundra, found by me!

lines.zh: 在这冰封之地，我是王者！
lines.en: In this frozen land, I reign!

lines.zh: 冰原上的暴君，谁能匹敌？
食物在我眼中，尽是猎物！
lines.en: All I see is prey, food!
Be my master, or rue the day!

lines.zh: 毛发灰暗者，吾将与你交配！
毛色暗者，吾欲与你交配！
毛色灰暗者，吾将与你同床！
毛色灰暗者，吾将与你共舞！
毛色灰暗者，吾将与你同眠！
毛色灰暗者，吾将与你交尾！
毛色灰暗者，吾将与你共生！
毛色灰暗者，吾将与你交合！
巨大象牙在地，啃食冰原植物。
lines.en: Tusks in the snow, munching ice plants.
Crown of a tyrant shows might.
The calf tucks itself behind my legs.

lines.zh: 灰毛首领朝你这边偏头。
lines.en: The grey leader tilts toward you.
You have cut our formation in two.

lines.zh: 我的长鼻竖起，闻到敌意。
雪下的振动告诉我你多重。
lines.en: The snow tells me how heavy you are.

lines.zh: 首领低吼一声，全群转向。
lines.en: The leader grunts and the herd turns.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢有人站进幼崽中间。
lines.en: I dislike anyone standing among the calves.

lines.zh: 这头戴冠的两脚兽想干什么。
lines.en: What does this crowned two-leg want?
I gather the calf inside my legs.
My tusks lower and point ahead.
The herd spreads into a half moon.
I lift a foreleg and hold it in the air.

lines.zh: 雪面下，我的重心沉了下去。
lines.en: Under the snow, my weight settles.
You back to the ice ridge. I do not follow.
The leader has taken its place behind me.

lines.zh: 我要用肩把你顶出队列。
lines.en: I will shoulder you out of the line.
Only once the calf is safe do I turn to you.
My trunk wraps you up and slams you into the snow.
My strength is unmatched on the tundra!

lines.zh: 紧抓不放，吞噬你的灵魂！
lines.en: Hold on and devour your soul!
None can stand against me in the cold!
Crush them with my sturdy legs!

lines.zh: 用角顶撞，粉碎所有阻碍！
lines.en: Smash all obstacles with my horn!

lines.zh: 寒冷的风中，我无坚不摧！
lines.en: I am unstoppable in the cold wind!
My tusks scoop you up the ice slope!
A shoulder charge, and snow fills the air!
My trunk cracks across your back!
Where my forefoot lands, the ice breaks!

lines.zh: 寒冰覆盖之下，我们诞生！

lines.en: Frozen for a millennium, now awake!

lines.zh: 育生舱门开了，我踏出来。
lines.en: The incubator opens and I step out.
DNA from permafrost pieced me back together.

lines.zh: 有机黏液还挂在我毛上。
lines.en: Organic slime still clings to my fur.
When I open my eyes, I see snow first.

lines.zh: 我从冰层裂缝里站起来。
lines.en: I stand up out of a crack in the ice.

lines.zh: 鼻子里灌满了远古的冷气。
lines.en: Ancient cold pours into my nostrils.

lines.zh: 我的影子压过整片雪原。
lines.en: My shadow crosses the whole snowfield.

lines.zh: 长鼻一扬，冰原有了主人。
lines.en: My trunk lifts; the steppe has a master.
The blast set even my tusks ringing.

lines.zh: 冰封的牙，从冰里露出来。
lines.en: Frozen tusks show through the ice.

lines.zh: 魔法的光在毛上烧出焦痕。
lines.en: Magic light scorches black marks into my coat.
The snow is deep. The grass is buried.

lines.zh: 虚空把整头象吞下去了。
lines.en: The void swallowed the whole mammoth.
